Create a CelltypeNetworkResult

Source: R/network-accessors.R
CelltypeNetworkResult.Rd

Wraps a network estimated elsewhere, or built by hand, in a CelltypeNetworkResult so that it can be compared with run_comparative_network and plotted. The networks returned by run_celltype_network and run_exposure_network are already of this class.

Usage

CelltypeNetworkResult(
  precision,
  adjacency,
  node_info,
  celltype,
  method = "precomputed",
  stability = NULL,
  metadata = list()
)

Arguments

precision

Numeric square matrix: the precision (inverse covariance) matrix, one row and column per feature.

adjacency

Symmetric matrix of edge indicators (1 = edge, 0 = no edge) with the dimensions of precision and a zero diagonal; a logical matrix is stored as 0/1 integers.

node_info

DataFrame or data.frame with one row per feature, in matrix order, a feature column without missing values and an omic_layer column, which the summaries, plots and comparisons read; the summaries and plots recognise the layers "transcript" and "metabolite". Row and column names of the matrices, where present, must equal feature, so that a misordered table is an error.

celltype

Character scalar: the cell type.

method

Character scalar: how the network was estimated. Default "precomputed".

stability

Optional matrix of edge selection frequencies between 0 and 1 with the dimensions of adjacency; NULL (default) stores none.

metadata

List of further information, for example n_donors, the number of donors as a whole number, which the show method and plot_celltype_network print.

Value

A valid CelltypeNetworkResult.

See also

network-accessors

Examples

features <- c("G1", "G2", "M1")
precision <- diag(3)
precision[1, 3] <- precision[3, 1] <- -0.4
adjacency <- (precision != 0) * 1L
diag(adjacency) <- 0L
dimnames(precision) <- dimnames(adjacency) <- list(features, features)
network <- CelltypeNetworkResult(
    precision = precision,
    adjacency = adjacency,
    node_info = S4Vectors::DataFrame(
        feature = features,
        omic_layer = c("transcript", "transcript", "metabolite")),
    celltype = "Monocyte",
    metadata = list(n_donors = 20L))
network
#> CelltypeNetworkResult for 'Monocyte'
#>   Method: precomputed
#>   Nodes: 3 (2 transcripts, 1 metabolites)
#>   Edges: 1 (1 cross-omic)
#>   Donors: 20
